description:
Browser where your favorite apps won't get buried in tabs.


🍪 Biscuit Release Note

⚡️New features
- Search recent downloads by file name or date, and cancel or retry downloads from the toolbar.
- Manage microphone and camera permissions separately for each site.
- Search settings, keyboard shortcuts, and saved passwords.

💪🏻Improvements
- Improved split-view controls, resizing, docking, and tooltips.
- Improved password detection and filling for modern and multi-step sign-in forms, with a smaller save/update card that appears after sign-in.
- Strengthened encrypted password storage and made migration from previous versions recoverable after interruptions. Previous encrypted data is retained for recovery.
- Added clearer initial sync comparisons, progress, and recovery backups before replacing settings.
- Refined settings navigation, app setup, browser imports, and layouts on smaller windows.
- Highlighted hostnames in the address bar and clarified available keyboard actions.

🐞Bug
- Fixed sidebar icons changing to icons from child tabs.
- Fixed confirmation when changing a group to separate app sessions.
- Prevented IME composition from accidentally confirming edits or searches.
- Improved modal focus, page search, theme contrast, and recovery from font-loading errors.
